in_sanskrit.name: Venkey
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Little Victory
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Venkey एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Venkey is derived from the Tamil words 'ven' meaning victory and 'key' meaning little. This name is a sign of strength and courage, and suggests that the person carrying this name will be victorious in their endeavors and will be a protector to those around them.
